Default `fetch_page`: one `occ_search` page for a single taxon key

Source: R/ecoregion_sampling.R
gbif_occ_search_page.Rd

Default `fetch_page`: one `occ_search` page for a single taxon key

Usage

gbif_occ_search_page(taxon_key, limit, start, time_to_sleep = 0.3)

Arguments

taxon_key

A GBIF usage key.

limit

(numeric) Page size.

start

(numeric) Offset of the first record of the page.

time_to_sleep

(numeric) Seconds to sleep before the call (GBIF rate-limiting courtesy delay).

Value

A tibble with `decimalLongitude`, `decimalLatitude` and, when available, `countryCode`, `year` and `gbifID`.
